title: Tertium (But Is It Art?)
summary: A native checkbox held by script in its third, undecided state, which your first click irreversibly collapses into a yes/no verdict.
mechanism: input.indeterminate=true renders the browser's script-only third state; a native checkbox click always clears it, so the excluded middle is unreachable by the user and destroyed on touch.
references: tertium non datur / the law of the excluded middle
